def rotate90(m):
    """Rotate 90 degrees clockwise"""
    n = len(m)
    return [[m[n-1-j][i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]

def rotate180(m):
    """Rotate 180 degrees"""
    n = len(m)
    return [[m[n-1-i][n-1-j] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]

def rotate270(m):
    """Rotate 270 degrees clockwise (or 90° counter-clockwise)"""
    n = len(m)
    return [[m[j][n-1-i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]

    elif k == 1:
